popularity_bias_elimination.rationale: Popularity metrics (such as GitHub star counts, download volumes, or social metrics) are strictly excluded from candidate filtering and ranking to eliminate popularity bias and ensure the benchmark represents authentic, diverse software engineering projects.

inclusion_criteria.automated_tests: Dedicated tests/ or test/ directory with executable pytest/unittest test suites
inclusion_criteria.release_anchors: Multiple tagged releases (Tier 1 preferred) OR clearly identifiable chronological commit milestones (Tier 2)
inclusion_criteria.ast_parseable: Source code parseable by standard Python 3 AST parser
inclusion_criteria.active_at_transition: Not archived or abandoned at sampled transition point
inclusion_criteria.project_type: Real software engineering project (libraries, CLI, utilities, web backend, infrastructure; excludes synthetic/tutorial/toy repositories)
inclusion_criteria.outcome_independence: Repository eligibility is evaluated strictly on repository-level engineering criteria, completely independent of RoleMem predictions or claim solvability.

exclusion_criteria.blacklist_rule: Candidate repository R (including any forks, renames, mirrors, or submodules) MUST NOT exist in the frozen contamination registry.
exclusion_criteria.historical_occurrence_prohibition: Candidate repository R must have zero occurrences across data/**, reports/**, runs/**, tests fixtures, previous benchmark manifests, or transition specs.
exclusion_criteria.forbidden_outcome_conditioning: Rejection based on claim difficulty, lack of stale transitions, or RoleMem abstention is strictly prohibited.

category_diversity_invariant.category_inclusion_invariant: Category balance CANNOT influence repository inclusion or exclusion. Repositories entering the candidate pool are evaluated strictly against objective history, activity, and test suite criteria. Functional categories serve as descriptive metadata for sample characterization, not as an inclusion quota.

sampling_steps: 1. Collect all candidate repositories satisfying objective inclusion criteria and passing contamination blacklist.
2. Sort candidates alphabetically by canonical repository URL to establish deterministic base ordering.
4. Select top N_target = 25 repositories sequentially from the permuted sequence.
5. If total eligible candidates N < 20, record FORMAL_REPOSITORY_SHORTFALL and halt.
seeded_sampling_specification.invariance_guarantee: Given the candidate pool and seed 3407, the selected repository list is mathematically unique and immutable.

repository_selection_report_schema.description: Strict schema for formal repository selection reports. Enforces recording of repository metadata only, prohibiting any transition, claim, or outcome leakage.

field_specifications.repository_name: String identifier (owner/name or canonical package name)
field_specifications.category: One of: libraries, developer_tools, data_utility, cli_packages, web_backend, infrastructure
field_specifications.history_duration_years: Float: calendar duration from first commit to latest commit in years
field_specifications.commit_count: Integer: total non-merge commits in primary branch
field_specifications.test_availability: String: description of test framework and test path (e.g. pytest under tests/)
field_specifications.license: String: SPDX license identifier or license description
field_specifications.primary_language_fraction: Float: percentage of Python source code in repository
field_specifications.selection_rank: Integer: deterministic rank index (1 to N) from seeded permutation
